# What's new in 0.2.0

Released **2026-10-02**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Trainer Emulator** for desk development — switch Real KICKR ↔ Emulator in Settings (even if the bike is offline)
- Emulator panel on the ride screen (side-by-side on laptop): sticky Set watts, Pause/Resume, Follow workout, presets
- Power history chart is now a line chart (adherence colors kept)
- Real KICKR / DirCon behavior unchanged for normal riding

## Installer

- `KICKR-Pi-0.2.0-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v0.2.0

Newer release: [0.3.0](../0.3.0/WHAT_IS_NEW.md).
